ranking.label: William T. Morrissey Boulevard (WHOLE ROAD: 2 parts merged, 63 segments, 10.4 km)
detour_or_disconnection_evidence: Columbia Point (UMass Boston area) -> nearest emergency department: 317 s baseline -> 351 s with mock-morrissey-closure closures (+11%); 317 s if this corridor stays passable (recovers 35 s).
assumptions: Impact = demand-weighted seconds recovered by keeping this corridor passable, conditional on all other closures in the scenario; unreachable journeys count as 3600 extra seconds.
Journeys are assumed planning proxies (neighborhood to emergency department), not ambulance dispatch or clinical appropriateness.
Scenario closures mean 'potentially closed', not verified impassable. Travel times are posted-speed estimates, no traffic.
Threshold crossings use an ASSUMED 600 s (10 min) planning threshold, not an official standard.
WHOLE-ROAD bundle: merges disconnected same-name parts (e.g. both carriageways). It overlaps the directional corridors listed separately; do not add their impacts together.

limitations: Closure set is MOCK, not a flood map.
Relative criticality for investigation, not a construction priority.
Assumed origins/destinations and equal demand weights unless replaced with sourced data.
Property damage, hardship and hydraulic effects are not part of this metric.
